LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_EmberDrain.label: [Raven] Ember Drain
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_EmberDrain.description:
This person's [Raven] Golden Crow bloodline essence has just been extracted by the "Ember Residue" extractor. The energy circuits within the body are in a state of extreme depletion and instability.

Until this condition clears, ember extraction cannot be performed again, as doing so would cause immediate death (safety protocols will prevent the device from activating).

This causes mild confusion and physical weakness.
